# Average Time Calculator

Average Time Calculator is a free, private browser tool for averaging time
values. It supports elapsed durations, times of day, weighted averages, and
running averages. All calculations run locally in the browser; no time data is
uploaded or stored.

## Key Concepts

- Duration average: sum all elapsed times and divide by the count.
- Clock time average: use circular mean so values crossing midnight are correct.
- Weighted average: sum time multiplied by weight, then divide by total weight.
- Running average: cumulative mean after each value in a list.
- Average pace: in duration mode, divide the mean time by a fixed distance to
  get pace per km or per mile.
- Result context: average, total, count, min, max, median, range or spread,
  and standard deviation.

## Formulas

- Duration average = total seconds / number of values.
- Weighted average = sum(time x weight) / sum(weight). A line such as "4m 20s,3"
  means that value represents three observations.
- Clock time circular mean: convert each time to an angle on a 24-hour circle,
  average the sine and cosine components, then convert the resulting angle back
  to a time. This keeps 23:50 and 00:10 averaging near 00:00 instead of 12:00.
- Standard deviation uses the sample formula (n - 1 denominator), matching the
  spreadsheet function =STDEV().
- Pace = mean duration in seconds / distance (km or mi), shown as m:ss per unit.

## Example

Input (one value per line):
1:32.40, 1:31.20, 1:33.10, 1:30.85

Each value is converted to seconds (92.40, 91.20, 93.10, 90.85), summed to
367.55 seconds, and divided by 4, giving an average of 91.8875 seconds, or
1:31.8875.

## Edge Cases

- Midnight crossing: 23:50 and 00:10 in clock mode average to 00:00 (circular
  mean), not 12:00 (plain arithmetic).
- Opposing times: 00:00 and 12:00 in clock mode are evenly opposite, so the
  average is reported as "Not defined" rather than a meaningless middle point.
- Milliseconds are preserved when present, e.g. 1:30.450.
- Mixed formats are accepted in one list: HH:MM:SS, MM:SS, seconds, 1h 23m 45s,
  1.5h, 45.5m, and 11:45 PM.
- Day units are accepted, e.g. 1d 4h 30m.
- Weighted mode rejects negative weights and lines without a weight.
- Pace requires duration mode, at least one value, and a positive distance.
- The calculator can be prefilled from a URL: ?mode=duration&values=1:30%0A1:25
  with optional &weighted=1, &running=1, and &format=hhmmss. New lines are
  encoded as %0A.

## Boundaries

- The tool does not add days to dates, convert time zones, or account for
  daylight saving time.
- It handles durations and single-day clock times only; it is not a date
  calculator.
- There is no limit on the number of input values, and results are computed in
  full precision before display rounding.
